name: Master Service Agreement
description: Standard MSA template covering scope, compensation, IP, indemnification, and termination.

clauses.title: 1. Scope of Services
clauses.body_text: Services shall be described in one or more Statements of Work ("SOW") attached hereto and incorporated by reference. Each SOW shall include the project description, deliverables, timeline, and acceptance criteria.

clauses.title: 2. Compensation
clauses.body_text: Client shall pay Provider the fees set forth in each SOW within {{payment_terms}} days of receipt of an invoice. Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month.

clauses.title: 3. Term and Termination
clauses.body_text: This Agreement shall remain in effect for a term of {{term_years}} year(s) from the Effective Date. Either party may terminate upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

clauses.title: 4. Confidentiality
clauses.body_text: Each party shall hold confidential information received from the other in strict confidence for a period of two (2) years following the termination of this Agreement.

clauses.title: 5. Indemnification
clauses.body_text: Each party shall indemnify, defend, and hold the other harmless from any third-party claims arising from the indemnifying party's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

clauses.title: 6. Governing Law
clauses.body_text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of {{governing_state}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.
